milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the fenced pig pen and visually observe the pigs. Target is the center of the pig pen at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5). With max_distance=8, the player (spawning ~7.07 blocks away) must walk a few steps toward the pen and face it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the pigs, not just passing nearby. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because 'find' tasks model visual observation, not just proximity.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must enter or approach the cave interior and visually identify the gold_ore blocks on the walls. Target is the center of the gold_ore cluster at spawn-relative (11, 1, 13). With max_distance=10, the player must walk past the pig pen and into or near the cave entrance (~17 blocks from spawn, requiring ~7+ blocks of travel). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the gold_ore deposits. This rule type correctly models 'player can see the target' without requiring them to stand on top of it.
